method: Fresh original-pixel visual inspection of the rebuilt 16-direction QA sheet. Each pose was compared with neutral and its two neighbors to verify the clockwise 0-degree-up screen-coordinate convention, cardinal anchors, diagonal quadrant, and screen-left versus screen-right displacement.

directions.observation: The eyes occupy their highest position with no added horizontal directional shift, clearly establishing the up cardinal.
The eyes remain at the upper reach and advance moderately toward screen-right, reading as the first up-right step.
The combined upward and screen-right displacement forms a clear upper-right diagonal.
The pose keeps its strong screen-right reach while reducing the upward component, correctly reading as mostly right and slightly up.
The eyes are at the screen-right extreme and vertically between the up and down anchors, clearly establishing the right cardinal.
The pose preserves the strong screen-right reach and adds a moderate downward shift, reading as mostly right and slightly down.
The combined screen-right and downward displacement forms a clear lower-right diagonal.
The eyes remain at the lower reach while returning moderately toward horizontal center, correctly reading as down-right.
The eyes occupy their lowest position with no added horizontal directional shift, clearly establishing the down cardinal.
The eyes remain at the lower reach and advance moderately toward screen-left, reading as the first down-left step.
The combined downward and screen-left displacement forms a clear lower-left diagonal.
The pose keeps its strong screen-left reach while reducing the downward component, correctly reading as mostly left and slightly down.
The eyes are at the screen-left extreme and vertically between the down and up anchors, clearly establishing the left cardinal.
The pose preserves the strong screen-left reach and adds a moderate upward shift, reading as mostly left and slightly up.
The combined screen-left and upward displacement forms a clear upper-left diagonal.
The eyes remain at the upper reach while returning moderately toward horizontal center, correctly completing the loop as up-left.
